# STAG Industrial to Participate in NAREIT Conference


STAG Industrial, Inc. announced today that it will be participating in NAREIT’s REITworld 2025 Annual Conference the week of December 8, 2025.


[Read More about "STAG Industrial to Participate in NAREIT Conference", Opens in new window, (PDF)](https://www.stagindustrial.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Press-Release-Conference-DEC-2025-12.4.2025.pdf)
